defs.meaning: 提醒，催函（reminder 的复数形式）

examples.en: Mr. Lawssi apparently did not return the money, despite repeated reminders.
examples.zh: 劳斯先生显然还没有还钱，尽管已经反复提醒过。

examples.en: We are less likely to lie when we have moral reminders or when we think others are watching.
examples.zh: 当有道德提醒我们或当感到有其他人在看我们时，我们就不太可能说谎。

examples.en: They wind out being guilt provoking reminders of the fact that will over committed and losing control of our priorities.
examples.zh: 它们最终会让我们感到内疚，提醒我们，这会让我们过度投入，失去对优先事项的控制。
